objective: Convert qualified demand into protected, compliant, collected gross profit with minimum SAHJONY capital exposure.
promotionRule: No opportunity advances without evidence for the current gate. No newsletter or marketplace lead is treated as a deal until buyer identity, authority, quantity, destination, timing and payment capability are verified.
economicsRule: No firm customer quote without supplier price, logistics, duties/fees, payment/FX costs, contingency and SAHJONY gross-profit calculation.
capitalRule: Prefer structures that avoid SAHJONY funding supplier performance from its own balance sheet. Payment, escrow, LC, documentary or other risk-mitigated structures must be validated per transaction.
